verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents a sandbox, test store, or test-mode environment for Shopify's agentic commerce surface. The quickstart and runtime probes run against live catalog and storefront endpoints; one probe even created a real cart on a live Shopify store. A local UCP profile and the long-lived cancellable carts are adjacent features, not sandbox isolation from production data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
